titleAr: مين بيدفع لميتا على الرقم بتاعي
titleEn: Who pays Meta for my own number (card on Meta)

ar: الرقم بتاعي مش بيبعت ومكتوب مين بيدفع لسه ما اتحددش
ازاي اخلي ميتا تخصم من الكارت؟
en: Who pays Meta for my own number?
My number says the payer is not set, how do I fix it?

steps: Wallet > Who pays WhatsApp: an own number whose payer is not set shows Let Meta bill my card
Preview says Meta will bill the card on your Meta account and the wallet will not pay; Yes, confirm writes it once (single-use token bound to the number)
Only the card is offered to a merchant: the platform line (the shared number) is refused with a plain 403 and stays the operator's
A number the operator put on the platform line is not taken back by the merchant (409 operator_funded)
edgeCases: Own numbers only: the shared number and another store's number answer 404
A confirmation is single-use, expires after 15 minutes and is bound to the number; an edited or replayed one is refused
Making Meta bill the card needs a card on your Meta account (see numbers.meta-payment-method)
Super admin keeps the operator route (operator.funding) for the platform line
